## Summary

Describe the change and any known limitations.

- [ ] Backlog ID and OpenSpec change link (or explain why not applicable).
- [ ] Real `pnpm verify` output included.
- [ ] Real `pnpm test:e2e`, format and strict OpenSpec output included.

- [ ] Affected documentation updated.
